title: Understanding Poetry — Caesura (Power & Conflict Analysis)
skills: identify pauses created within poetic lines
analyze how caesura affects pacing, emphasis, and tone
explain how structural pauses contribute to meaning and interpretation
alignment_note: Introduces caesura as a structural pause within a poetic line and explores how it can shape pacing, emphasis, tone, and meaning. Supports close reading, poetry analysis, interpretation of line structure, and analysis of author's craft across high school English courses.
